title: Brightfall
generation_prompt: Original all-ages future-bass instrumental for a beginner-friendly one-or-two-key rhythm game at a STRICT constant 142 BPM in 4/4 for 128 seconds. The main subject is a clearly quantized and continuously audible DRUM MACHINE: a strong short kick on EVERY quarter note from the FIRST BEAT to the FINAL BAR, dry snare on EVERY beat two and four, crisp closed hi-hat on EVERY eighth note, and a short bright woodblock or pluck accent at least once in EVERY bar. Keep these exact four-to-the-floor beat markers exposed through every transition and quieter passage; do not drop, mute, filter, swing, delay or half-time the kick. Do not use a drumless intro, sparse ambient breakdown, tempo drift, free-time music or long reverberant tails that smear attacks. Over this stable grid, play a distinct hook of four ascending bell-pluck notes that stops for one beat, answered by three lower descending marimba-synth notes just after the next downbeat. Add a rounded offbeat bass and restrained sidechained chord swells BEHIND the beat markers, with controlled highs. At the midpoint keep the same unwavering kick/snare/hat grid while swapping the two hook instruments and changing chord inversion; in the final quarter bring a higher counterline and a new resolving cadence instead of looping the first half. One evolving 128-second stereo composition, bright and playful without harsh distortion. No vocals, speech, sampled recordings, known melody or imitation of an existing song.
cover_prompt: Create a brand-new SQUARE 1:1 original album cover for duohertz track Brightfall, an all-ages future-bass rhythm-game song. Original high-contrast editorial comic screen-print collage: near-black ink, warm-ivory paper, electric cyan and one bold warm-yellow accent, with coral reserved for a few response beats. Main motif: ONE giant angular warm-yellow sound beam descends diagonally from the upper left into a single thick cyan folded impact plate at center; from that plate THREE separate oversized coral and ivory echo chips rebound upward toward the right. Show a clear cause-and-answer direction, with tactile cut-paper shadows and restrained halftone, readable at 100px. Keep the lower fifth mostly near-black for a local title overlay. This is abstract rhythmic energy, not falling water, sunlight, landscape or a real impact. No sun disc, circles, rings, lightning bolt, confetti scatter, floating islands, people, text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks or copied game art.
og_prompt: Edit the supplied original Brightfall square cover into a HORIZONTAL 1.9:1 duohertz social-sharing card. Preserve the giant warm-yellow descending sound beam, single thick cyan folded impact plate and three large separate coral/ivory echo chips rebounding toward the right, with near-black comic screen-print texture and sparse halftone. Recompose the motif on the RIGHT two-thirds; leave a calm near-black LEFT third. Add exactly two crisp legible English lines there: 'duohertz' all lowercase in electric cyan and 'Brightfall' in larger warm ivory. Spell both exactly. No other text, letters, numbers, circles, sun, water, landscape, people, logos, watermarks or copied game art. Make a purpose-built wide card rather than a stretched square crop.
